lots.what_it_is: Mixed lot led by a 1980s Barbie 4x4 jeep (cream and orange, brown roll bars, rear winch) and the matching brown Barbie horse trailer with the desert sunset Barbie decal, plus two Wife and Home magazines (Holiday Knitting Number, 6d, pre-decimal), two small costume dolls, a studio pottery COFFEE jar with cork lid, a floral pressed tin and white embroidered linen. No horses, figures or windscreen seen.

sold.note: Page opened (API record and lot photo viewed). BOX OF BARBIE TOYS INCL JEEPS, HORSES & FLOATS: photo shows the same brown trailer and cream jeep plus two Barbie horses with a saddle, so more complete than ours. Only 1 bid. Hammer, Gowans premium extra. AUD, rate 1.0.

lots.guide_summary: All AUD (rate 1.0), all SOLD hammers at Gowans, no unsold or asking evidence. Close match: the same jeep and trailer with two horses made $45 hammer on 1 bid (Jan 2026). Category guide (dropped from the list, see below): Gowans boxes of mixed Barbie toys and vehicles usually make $15 to $50 hammer.
lots.working: Keep: lowest surviving same-item SOLD = $45 (Gowans 384973, Jan 2026, within 24 months, close match but more complete with two horses). 45 / 1.22 = 36.9, round down to $35. Flip: likely resale about $45 (the one sold result); less about 20% selling fees and costs (~$9; pickup sale, no postage) = $36; 36 / 2.44 = 14.8, round down to $10. Our lot lacks the horses so resale could easily be lower; the magazines, tin and jar add a few dollars at most.
lots.confidence_reason: Identification is clear from the Barbie decal on the trailer and matches the Gowans photo, but no Mattel or date mark was read and there is only one close SOLD result, on a single bid.
lots.dropped_entries: Dropped Gowans 381346 ($10, 2 BOXES OF ASST TOYS & BARBIE TRUCK): photo opened, the Barbie vehicle is a modern pink camper, not this jeep. Dropped Gowans 381056 ($15, BOX INCL BARBIE HORSE, CARS & ASST CLOTHING): photo opened, the vehicles are a 1990s pink convertible and white limousine, not this set; category guide only. Dropped the aggregated '$20 to $30' entry (ids 409039 $30, 419940 $20, 426374 $25, 408511 $35, 429630 $50): it is a made-up midpoint of several generic Barbie boxes, not one sale; the individual hammers are confirmed in the Gowans API but are category guide only.
lots.key_photo_findings: One photo only. Trailer carries a clear Barbie script decal with the desert sunset badge and pink and purple stripes, matching the 1980s Barbie horse trailer. Jeep is cream with orange seats, brown roll bars and a winch, no windscreen visible. No horse, doll or accessories. Magazines show Wife and Home Holiday Knitting Number, 6d, year not legible. The jar reads COFFEE.
lots.condition: Jeep and trailer look complete in shape but grubby with some yellowing of the cream plastic; windscreen not seen. Other items cannot be judged from one photo.
lots.question_for_armitage: Is there a windscreen with the jeep, and are any Barbie horses or figures included? Any cracks or missing parts on the jeep or trailer?
